title: Catalog Section Finder
description: Card sorter: the learner assigns ten customer questions to the ten sections of a Twin City Fan product catalog (Catalog 300 order plus Catalog 902's performance data) and gets reason-based feedback; two attempts per card, first attempt scored, with a summary of first-try misses.
creator: Twin City Fan
subject: product catalog
catalog structure
engineering data
material specifications
performance data
typical specifications
rights: Copyright 2026 Twin City Fan. All rights reserved.

educational.audience: Adult professional development: new application engineers, sales staff, representatives and facilities staff
educational.topic: Finding answers in a Twin City Fan product catalog
learningObjectives: The learner will classify ten customer questions by the Twin City Fan catalog section that answers them, getting at least 8 of 10 right on the first attempt.

accessibility.notes: describe() text (fallback mode); card text, verdicts and the summary are announced through FP.announce (aria-live); each section button's aria-label carries the section description; ✓/✗ glyphs and solid/dashed borders pair with colour on the feedback panel and the chips; keys 1-9 and 0 assign the card, Enter goes to the next card or starts over.

controls.label: 1-9, 0 catalog sections
controls.purpose: Assign the face-up question to that section (keys 1-9, 0); hover or focus shows the section description

controls.label: Next card
controls.purpose: Turn up the next card; on the last card, Show summary (Enter)

controls.label: Start over
controls.purpose: Reshuffle all ten cards and clear the score

rules: Each card has exactly one correct section; each section is correct for exactly one card
Two attempts per card; only the first is scored
The correct section is named after the second attempt
Mastery is 8 of 10 correct on the first attempt
assumptions: Section order follows Catalog 300; Performance Data is the section Catalog 902 adds
limitations: Other Twin City Fan catalogs may group or title sections differently

sources: Twin City Fan Catalog 300, BC Backward Inclined Fans (April 2024), pages 2-3, 4, 5, 6-9, 10-12, 16, 17, dimensions, 50-51
Twin City Fan Catalog 902, RB Industrial Fans (November 2017), performance data from page 20 (RBA 913, page 24)

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Classify realistic questions by the kind of answer they need, committing each card before feedback
keyQuestions: Which catalog section answers this question?
Is this a can-it-be-built, how-will-it-perform or what-will-it-look-like question?
commonMisconceptions: Every catalog has printed performance tables.
Maximum speed is found in the performance tables rather than in engineering data.
Dimension pages can be used for construction.
assessmentOpportunities: Running score 'First-try correct: n of 10'; mastery is 8 of 10 on the first attempt; the summary lists first-try misses with reasons.
